description: Searches the Verateca register of dietary supplements by product name, brand, ingredient or barcode. Returns up to 10 published products with id, brand, form, page address, lowest price per day where prices are published, number of offers and the date the record was checked. Results are ordered by match, never by payment.

country.description: Two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) of the person. Limits of this country come first. Default US.

query.description: Product name, brand, ingredient or barcode (UPC/EAN).

name: search_products
title: Search products
